title: api.HTTPServer.configureTLS is the full TLS reference implementation
answers: Where is the complete/production TLS setup for Grafana's HTTP servers?
Where is cert_pass-encrypted key handling and cert hot-reload implemented?
Which TLS config should I copy for a new internal server?
body: For a fuller TLS implementation that supports encrypted private keys (cert_pass) and watching/reloading certs on disk (cfg.CertWatchInterval), look at api.HTTPServer.configureTLS rather than the minimal instrumentationTLSConfig helper added for the instrumentation server. Use it as the template when a new internal server needs production-grade TLS beyond a static cert/key pair.
applies: any Grafana-internal server needing TLS beyond the minimal static-cert case
says: How to enable encrypted certificate keys and hot reloading
Where is production TLS support with encrypted pass-phrase keys
Setting up HTTPS with automatic certificate reload on disk changes
Production-ready TLS implementation reference for internal API servers
Certificate file watching and encrypted key handling in HTTPS setup
search: api.HTTPServer.configureTLS is the full, production-grade TLS reference implementation supporting encrypted private keys (cert_pass) and on-disk certificate watching/reloading (cfg.CertWatchInterval). Use it as a template when implementing TLS for an internal Grafana server requiring these production features beyond static cert/key pairs. The instrumentationTLSConfig helper in pkg/server/instrumentation_service.go is minimal and unsuitable as a reference for full TLS implementations.
